label: Jetted Chest Pocket

profile.distinguishingDetail: The double-jetted, or besom, breast pocket presents only two thin parallel strips of cloth flanking a neat slit — with no welt standing above the opening. This is the most formal of all chest pocket treatments, de rigueur on black tie dinner jackets and white tie coats, where any additional fabric would disturb the polished, uninterrupted front. The parallel jets must be cut with meticulous precision: their width should be identical, their edges perfectly parallel, and the corners mitered with surgical accuracy — qualities that distinguish a master tailor's work.
